import math

def check_expression(a, b, c):
    K = 1001
    try:
        # E = sqrt(K/c) + sqrt(K/a) + sqrt(K/b)
        term1 = math.sqrt(K / c)
        term2 = math.sqrt(K / a)
        term3 = math.sqrt(K / b)
        E = term1 + term2 + term3
        # Check if E is very close to an integer
        is_integer = abs(E - round(E)) < 1e-9
        return E, is_integer
    except ZeroDivisionError:
        return None, False

# Test cases
test_cases = [
    (1, 1, 1),
    (1, 1, 7),
    (7, 7, 7),
    (1001, 1001, 1001),
    (1, 1001, 1001)
]

results = {}
for a, b, c in test_cases:
    E, is_int = check_expression(a, b, c)
    results[(a, b, c)] = (E, is_int)

for tc, (E, is_int) in results.items():
    print(f"Triple {tc}: E = {E:.6f}, Is Integer = {is_int}")
